payload.text: With DEVBIN_CACHE_HOME unset or empty the cache root is the XDG default; with no registry there, cache get is a miss (exit 1), the build runs and cache put makes the root and the entry; with an unusable root (a relative value, a file, an unwritable directory) get and put each say so once with exit 3, and the build's own exit is unchanged (WP16, D68; exit 3 by vc's decision 110).
